headline: Tata Sons May Face Mandatory Listing Under RBI NBFC Framework
summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra signaled that Tata Sons may have to list publicly following its classification as an Upper-Layer Core Investment Company under central bank regulations governing access to public funds.
why: Tata Sons is the principal holding company of the Tata Group conglomerate, and a mandatory public listing would represent one of India's largest-ever capital markets events.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: Stricter RBI listing compliance for upper-layer NBFCs forces major private corporate holding entities into public scrutiny.
